event_properties.content: Which locations are failing to deliver on time ?

Great news — there are no delivery timing issues at **Globeco Technologies pvt ltd**. All 2 reviews are positive, with no complaints about late deliveries or service delays. Customers have praised the team for being responsive and delivering on time.

You're doing great! With a perfect 5.0 rating and 100% positive feedback, there's no pressing issue to fix right now. Since you only have 2 reviews so far, the best move is to encourage more customers to share their experience — this will help you spot patterns and keep improving as you grow.

📉 **Recent Complaint Surge**
Your rating dropped from 4.2 to 3.0 in the first week of May — 4 out of 4 reviews during that period were complaints, compared to just 2 out of 21 in the prior week.

⚠️ **What Customers Are Saying**
The pattern is clear: guests feel the food quality doesn't match the pricing or the beautiful ambience. Common frustrations include dishes tasting bland or off (especially fish and mushroom curry), rock-hard garlic naan, overly salty noodles, and service that feels slow or inattentive. Many mentioned they're paying for the view, not the meal.

✅ **Immediate Action Step**
Conduct a kitchen audit this week focusing on ingredient freshness, seasoning consistency, and cook times — especially for paneer, naan, and curries. Pair this with a service speed check during peak hours to address the lag guests are noticing.
Which dishes received the most complaints?

🍽️ **Most Complained Dishes**
Customers flagged **paneer tikka** (undercooked), **garlic naan** (hard, no garlic flavor), **noodles** (too salty), **mushroom curry** (sour sauce, unpleasant smell), **cheese balls** (poor taste), and **fish** (not fresh). Mocktails like **Cinderella** and **strawberry drinks** were also criticized for being half-filled with ice.

⚠️ **Core Pattern**
Across the board, guests felt the food didn't match the pricing or the ambience. Execution issues like undercooking, over-salting, and ingredient freshness came up repeatedly — suggesting kitchen prep and quality checks need attention.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Run a full taste test on these dishes with your kitchen team at **Vayu by Shankar Bhavan**. Focus on seasoning balance, cooking times, and ingredient sourcing — especially for paneer, fish, and sauces.
How many 1-star reviews did I get this week?

You received **8 one-star reviews** this week — 5 on Zomato, 2 on Swiggy, and 1 on Google. I've flagged the top 3 most detailed ones for your review. Would you like me to draft response templates for them?
Can you summarise this week's feedback?

This week: **247 total reviews** across all platforms. 68% positive, 18% neutral, 14% negative. Highlights: customers love the new dessert menu. Pain points: parking, wait times on Friday evenings. Net Promoter Score estimate: **+34** (up from +29 last week).
Which menu items are highest in negative feedback?

🍽️ **Top Problem Items**
Based on the feedback, **pancakes** and **egg-based dishes** drew the most complaints. Customers flagged soggy pancakes from delivery delays and food safety concerns with eggs.

⚠️ **What Customers Experienced**
Guests mentioned that pancakes arrived too wet to enjoy, likely from syrup soaking through during transit. One diner reported a serious stomach issue after eating eggs, pointing to a potential freshness or storage problem. Oily food was also a recurring theme in kids' meals.

✅ **Immediate Action**
Package pancake syrup separately for all delivery orders and audit your egg storage and prep protocols today. Consider a freshness check on all breakfast items and reduce oil use in children's portions.
Which menu items are highest in negative feedback?

🍨 **Top Problem Items**
The **sundae** at **Ice-Cream Factory** drew the harshest criticism — customers felt the ingredients were low-quality and stale, with multiple guests saying they had to throw it away despite the ₹460+ price tag.

⚠️ **Other Recurring Issues**
At **Alice in Gelatoland**, the **waffle** was flagged for tasting stale, and the **mango dessert** was described as overly sweet with fruit that didn't seem fresh. Delivery delays made frozen items arrive soggy, amplifying quality concerns.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Audit ingredient freshness and supplier quality for these three items immediately. Consider removing the sundae temporarily until you can source better components — protecting your brand is worth more than one menu item.
